meta.title: Information Request List Extractor | GST
meta.description: Convert a filled Information Request List (.xlsx) into canonical markdown in your browser. The workbook is never uploaded.
meta.ogDescription: Turn a filled IRL workbook into the canonical markdown gst_irl_sweep expects, deterministically and entirely in the browser.
jsonld.description: Convert a filled Information Request List workbook into the canonical markdown body, deterministically and entirely in the browser
jsonld.feature.markdown: Filled .xlsx converted to canonical markdown client-side
jsonld.feature.parity: Byte-identical to the operator extractor for the same workbook
jsonld.feature.verbatim: Answered rows carried across verbatim with status and sourcing
header.subtitle: Turn a filled IRL workbook into the canonical markdown the sweep expects. Same bytes in, same text out, every time.
intro.body: A filled .xlsx has to become text before gst_irl_sweep can read it. This page does that in your browser, carrying every answered row across exactly as written with its status and any sourcing. Need the blank workbook first? Use the Information Request List Generator.
notice.outputEnglish: The markdown keeps its labels in English because the sweep reads them. Requests and answers stay as written in the workbook.
notice.contractEnglish: The sweep contract is available in English only.
pick.label: 01 / Choose the workbook
diag.label: What came back
out.label: 02 / Canonical markdown
idle.text: Pick a workbook and its canonical markdown appears here, ready to paste into the sweep's filledIrl argument.
error.title: Nothing to extract
card.private.title: The file never leaves your machine
card.private.item1: Your browser reads the workbook and converts it locally
card.private.item2: Nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored, and no account is involved
card.private.item3: Close the tab and it is gone
card.use.title: What to do with the markdown
card.use.item1: Paste it into gst_irl_sweep's filledIrl argument to get the dossier back. The sweep contract lists everything that comes back.
card.use.item2: Every row reading <NO RESPONSE> is a request the target did not answer. Those are the questions still outstanding, so read them before you pass the markdown on.
js.error.noRows.body: No request rows were found in “{sheet}”, so there is nothing to convert.
js.error.noRows.hint: This does not look like an Information Request List. “{sheet}” is the sheet that was read.
js.error.tooLarge.body: “{file}” is {size} MB. This tool reads workbooks up to {max} MB.
js.error.tooLarge.hint: An IRL workbook is normally well under a megabyte — check this is the request list and not a data export.
js.error.unreadable.body: “{file}” could not be opened as a spreadsheet.
js.error.unreadable.hint: Export it as .xlsx and try again.
js.advisory.unanswered.one: The only row is unanswered, so this looks like a template that has not been filled in yet. It converted, but there is nothing in it to sweep.
js.advisory.unanswered.other: All {count} rows are unanswered, so this looks like a template that has not been filled in yet. It converted, but there is nothing in it to sweep.
js.advisory.ceiling: {bytes} bytes exceeds the ~{ceiling}-byte ceiling for a claude.ai web prompt argument. The body is still valid; paste it in the desktop app.
